conceptZh: 小熊玩偶慢半拍模仿消防車的每個動作，噴出的蜂蜜水花剛好落成熊字。
object: a chunky toy fire engine with a hose and a bear plush that copies it
morph: a copycat bear echoes the fire crew one beat late while 熊 forms
creativeAngle: 模仿：小熊跟著消防車做，慢半拍搞出混亂。
promptEn: An 8-second animated clip on a pale honey-cream background, with one single Traditional Chinese glyph 熊 as the only text on screen, drawn in deep chestnut brown solid strokes, centered, uncropped, about 70% of frame height with generous margins. 0-1.7s: a chunky red toy fire engine rolls in and honks its siren; the first 熊 is spoken as the top 能 strokes drop in with a clunk. 1.7-3.4s: a round brown bear plush in a red scarf copies each move one beat late, ending nose-to-bumper with the engine; the second 熊 is spoken as the four fire-dots at the bottom pop in like water beads. 3.4-5s: 小熊 is spoken as the hose swings and sprays honey-colored droplets, the bear catching them with his tongue while the engine's lights spin. 5-8s: hold; both do a small matched wiggle, the bear a little late, glyph still. Audio: a warm off-screen voice in clear Taiwanese Mandarin reads exactly "熊、熊、小熊" (ㄒㄩㄥˊ、ㄒㄩㄥˊ、ㄒㄧㄠˇ ㄒㄩㄥˊ), slowly and distinctly with clear tones, a short pause between the two single utterances, and stops after the word; no other speech, no subtitles, no vocabulary text. Final 3 seconds (5-8s): the glyph 熊 is perfectly still and fully readable while the lead keeps a small joyful motion away from the strokes. Bright but not neon palette, no watermark, no flashing, no other writing.

conceptZh: 浣熊花生頂著搖搖欲墜的積木小隊，為了按一顆小小的蜂蜜門按鈕卯足全力衝刺，結果整個衝過頭、腳底冒煙滑回來，飛出去的積木剛好疊成「能」、煙圈落成四點變成熊字，輕輕一按門開了，一隻小熊探頭出來。
object: a wobbling column of building bricks on a raccoon's head and a tiny red button on a honey-pot door
morph: the overshoot flings the brick squad off Peanut's head; they clatter down and lock into the 能 top (厶 over 月 on the left, two stacked 匕 on the right), then four smoke puffs from his skidding feet drop and harden into the 灬 dots beneath
creativeAngle: 全新「用力過猛」橋段取代前版的慢半拍模仿：小任務（按一顆小按鈕）配上誇張大衝刺，衝過頭的撞擊本身把積木摔成「能」，煙腳落成四點，第二次輕輕一按才成功並讓「小熊」真的現身，聽到的詞與畫面完全同步；花生的錯時敬禮貫穿頭尾當個性記號。
promptEn:
An 8-second 2D cartoon clip on a soft butter-yellow background. The only text ever on screen is the single Traditional Chinese glyph 熊, built from solid deep-chestnut-brown pieces, centered, uncropped, about 70% of frame height with clear margins. Lead: Peanut, a small cartoon raccoon sidekick with a striped tail and a tiny cap, balancing a wobbling column of interlocking building bricks on his head that is far too tall for him.

0–1.5s: Peanut stands at the left, brick tower swaying. On the right sits a round honey-pot door with one tiny red button. He stares at the button, salutes at the wrong moment, and the tower lurches. The first 熊 is spoken as he narrows his eyes and points at the button with great seriousness.

1.5–3.5s: Peanut crouches into a huge wind-up, feet spinning in a blur, then rockets across the frame and sails straight PAST the button with a whoosh. The brick squad flies off his head, tumbles through the air with little alarmed faces, and clatters down in the center: the bricks lock together into the top part 能, a 厶 over 月 standing on the left and two stacked 匕 shapes on the right. The second 熊 is spoken as the last brick clicks in.

3.5–5s: Peanut skids back from off-screen right with smoking feet, dragging four fat little smoke puffs behind him; the puffs drop in a row beneath 能 and harden into the four dots 灬, finishing the glyph 熊. Dizzy grin. He raises one claw and taps the button ever so gently. The honey-pot door swings open and a tiny golden bear cub pops out hugging a honey pot. 小熊 is spoken exactly as the cub appears.

5–8s: the glyph 熊 holds perfectly still and fully readable in the center. Off to the right, Peanut snaps a proud salute, the cub salutes back one beat late, and wisps of smoke still curl from Peanut's feet. Nothing touches the strokes.

Audio: a warm, friendly off-screen voice in clear Taiwanese Mandarin reads exactly "熊、熊、小熊" (ㄒㄩㄥˊ、ㄒㄩㄥˊ、ㄒㄧㄠˇ ㄒㄩㄥˊ), slowly and distinctly with clear tones, a short pause between the two single utterances, and stops after the word. Soft cartoon whoosh, clatter and tiny door-creak effects under the voice. No subtitles, no vocabulary text, no other writing, no watermark, no flashing. Bright but not neon colors, clean uncluttered staging with only Peanut, the bricks and the honey-pot door on screen.
